articleTitle: A Microsoft-Platform based App for Vehicle Problem Solutions and Navigation: Phonomech
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: This study presents an innovative vehicle assistance and navigation app called Phonomech. The app aims to provide drivers with efficient solutions to vehicle problems and reliable navigation assistance. Phonomech utilizes map technology to identify nearby garages and service centers, ensuring prompt and convenient support in case of vehicle breakdowns or maintenance requirements. This study discusses the features and functionalities of Phonomech that enable drivers to effectively navigate and access essential services. The proposed app enhances the overall driving experience by offering real-time traffic information, personalized route suggestions, and seamless integration with Microsoft platforms. Comparative analysis is performed to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of Phonomech compared to existing vehicle assistance apps. The research work concludes with suggestions for future enhancements and improvements to further optimize the app’s capabilities.

articleTitle: Assessment of SSR and Stability Prediction in a Series Capacitive Compensated Wind Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Resources for producing renewable energy are being considered as options to produce electricity without creating pollution. According to statistics, wind energy is the most popular renewable energy source worldwide. Despite increasing the power transfer capacity Series compensation for transmission lines is essential because it improves their ability to switch electricity. Using series compensation is also results in the sub synchronous resonance (SSR) anomaly, during that mechanical and electrical herbal frequencies coincide and alternate, activating the herbal torsional modes of the turbine generating unit so the series compensated line is receptive to the Sub Synchronous Resonance (SSR) anomaly. In addition to the series compensation, sub synchronous phenomena can also be caused by wind generators. In this study, the wind energy conversion benchmark system used to compute the Eigen values for different compensation level to find the stability of the system during SSR. Using the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the state matrix, the oscillations of the energy machine are described in element. The efficacy of the technique employed enhances the usefulness of transmission. Further, EMTDC/PSCAD software was used for time domain simulation.

articleTitle: Automatic Selection of Active Phase in a 3-Phase Supply System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to provide a continuous flow of AC power, at a voltage of 230 volts, to a single-phase load. This is accomplished by automatically transferring the load from the missing phase to the next available phase in a three-phase system. It has been observed that 70% of power outages in distribution systems are caused by single-phase failures, while the other two phases remain operational. As a result, in any commercial or domestic power system that has three phases, it’s advisable to have an automatic switching system in place to ensure uninterrupted power to critical loads in case of a missing phase. The automatic selection in this three-phase supply system is accomplished through the use of interconnecting relays, with one relay feeding the load at all times. In the event of a phase failure, the corresponding step-down transformer is activated through a transistor assembly. The three phases are referred to as the R phase, Y phase, and B phase. To manage the switching of the phases, there are three switches. The LED on the left indicates which phase is on or off, while the LED and relays on the right show which supply is powering the load.

articleTitle: Preparing Next-Gen Trailblazers: An EFA-Driven Investigation of Problem-Solving Skills of Employability in Computer Science Graduates
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to pinpoint the underlying variables that influence problem-solving abilities in computer science graduates. An exhaustive examination of the literature, the gathering of data via surveys, and Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) were all components of the three-stage research technique. The survey includes 562 computer science graduates from various institutions and universities in India. Problem-solving skills were the subject of an EFA on 31 statements, and the results revealed a five-factor structure that accounted for 78.126% of the overall variation. The identified factors were of Impulsive Style, Planning and Monitoring, Problem-Solving Confidence, Reflective Style, and Avoidance Style. Reliability analysis using Cronbach’s alpha revealed satisfactory internal consistency for each factor, with values ranging from.848 to.933. These results offer a thorough grasp of the fundamental elements of problem-solving abilities, which may be applied to the creation of focused interventions and training courses to improve problem-solving skills in computer science graduates.

articleTitle: Revelation of Adulteration in Ghee by fumigation Method and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Ghee made from cow’s milk is considered the holiest of foods in Indian culture. Its nutritional content is so high that it is widely employed in Ayurvedic treatments, and with good reason. It is a staple diet in India because of the many positive effects it has on people’s health, including boosting their immune, strengthening their bones, feeding their brains and eyes, and so on. Ghee made from pure cow’s milk follows a standard procedure: the milk is fermented into curd, the curd is churned to separate the butter and buttermilk, and the butter is then heated to a specific temperature to create ghee. All of these steps add up to a hefty price tag. This, however, also means that Ghee is more susceptible to being tainted. Adulteration harms health and the economy. This study used an E-Nose to detect cow milk ghee adulteration. The cow milk ghee was cooked for varied intensities of tarnishing by Dalda (80%, 60%, 40%, 20% adulteration) and the fumes were provided to the sensors of the proposed Electronic Nose. Sensor conductance determines adulteration. Classifiers assessed findings in terms of 80-90% accuracy on various on different proportions of Train-Test Sample.

articleTitle: Reliability and Packet Transfer Efficiency of Sparkle Topologies
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Distributed computing through topology control involves making changes to the underlying network (modeled as a graph) to decrease the cost of distributed algorithms when executed across the modified networks. Topology construction builds reduced topology and topology maintenance adopts the reduced topology when the current topology is no longer optimal. This study makes major contributions to topology control by constructing new topologies named sparkle topologies using a ring topology, structured web topology, sun topology, and star topology. The efficiency of the sparkle topologies is checked by calculating the reliability using Wiener Index and data transfer using Cisco packet simulation. Data transmission times, the number of hops required, and the number of potential failure points are all reduced in sparkle topologies compared to ring topologies.

articleTitle: Numeric-Digit Identifier based on Convolutional Neural Networks on Field-Programmable Gate Array
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are increasingly employed for voice recognition, image segmentation, and digit classification. Hardware support techniques are required as the need for processing power rises, and programmable hardware such as FPGAs are ideal for CNN workloads. The suggested approach is to recognize the digit using the MNIST dataset and hardware realization of CNN acceleration to minimize processing time and complexity. The is identified with 2 hidden and 2 convolution layers, developed in Verilog HDL for Xilinx Zynq 7Z020 FPGA with considerations for size, power, and logical consumption.

articleTitle: Design of a Solar Fed Phase Shift Full Bridge Converter for Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The work suggests utilising the different optimization techniques to design a solar power fed Phase Shift Full Bridge (PSFB) DC-DC converter to feed a 48 Volt DC microgrid which can be used to satisfy the voltage levels of household appliances. Microgrid is a compact network of electricity consumers with a nearby power source that is typically connected to a centralised grid but has the capacity to operate on its own. These Solar-powered fed PSFBs can also be used to charge these batteries. Solar energy is employed as the converter’s input source since it is abundant and simple to install, making it a viable renewable energy source. A MPPT approach is used to get the most power out of PV panels. The duty cycle of the switching signals produced by the MPPT control algorithm are sent to the converter. Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA) and Emperor Penguin Optimization (EPO) serves as the control algorithm in this situation. They are metaheuristic algorithm that makes sure the PV panel functions at the best voltage and current in order to harvest the most electricity under all climatic situations. The remainder of the solar energy is used to charge the battery when the converter reaches the desired power. By Using Matlab 2015a/Simulink, the overall system efficiency is calculated based on the metaheuristic approach utilised for MPPT tracking. This article suggests a solar-powered fed PSFB that is SSA and EPO based, which works well as an approach for feeding the energy source to the microgrid and battery.

Author Keywords: Phase Shift Full Bridge DC-DC Converter

articleTitle: Electrical Grid Stability Prediction using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) is a technique that helps applications makes accurate predictions by using input to predict output values. There are various ML models that provide different results, each representing an alternative to other models with the goal of improving prediction performance. ML is used in different fields to provide good predictions and make the right decisions based on the subject. The current application of ML is predicting electricity grid stability, which aims to forecast problems that may arise in the grid when renewable energy is used, or when electricity production is insufficient to meet consumer needs. This prediction is based on the Dataset a processed and simulated input dataset that has been used by various ML models. Ultimately, the best ML model will be selected for accurate prediction.

articleTitle: Paddy Plant Leaf Disease Classification based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: One of the main dangers to food supply security has been paddy leaf disease. Disease diagnosis has shown to be a significant challenge in terms of precision and accuracy. Deep learning enabled recent developments in computer vision to make it possible. The classification of numerous rice leaf diseases has been quite successful when deep learning and CNN is used. A number of neural and layered visualization techniques were used with a convolutional neural network trained on a diseased rice leaf image dataset. Once diagnosed, neural networks have been shown to be able to record the hues and surface of lesions unique to a specific disease. This is similar to human intelligence.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Adhesive Application System for Magnets in Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Electric Motors requires Permanent Magnets in them to function. The following paper explains the design, construction and critical analysis of an Adhesive applicant machine for magnets in rotor casings [1] [2]. articleTitle: An Empirical Study on E-Commerce Site using Unique AI based Features and Data Science Tools

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Integration of IoT Systems for Smart Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: The smart grid has grown to be a major study topic due to the rising need for Renewable Energy Sources (RES) and the requirement to efficiently control energy usage. A smart grid is intelligent and energy-efficient could be developed by integrating cloud-based IoT technology with RES. In order to increase energy efficiency, reduce energy losses, and assure reliable power distribution, this work presented a unique technique for the incorporation of RES utilizing IoT and multilevel converters. The suggested method makes use of IoT devices’ capacity to gather, process, and analyze data in order to improve grid control and track the effectiveness of renewable energy installations. To ensure the grid operates steadily and effectively, a multilevel converter is utilized to optimize power distribution, voltage management, and power quality (PQ). The efficacy and viability of the suggested strategy are demonstrated by the results of its validation utilizing a model for simulation in MATLAB/Simulink.

Author Keywords: Renewable energy and power conditioning unit

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Microstrip Patch Antenna with Different Slots and Substrate Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: Modern wireless communication highly depends on antenna. A “low-profile Microstrip Patch Antenna” (MPA) with increased gain for wireless communication is presented in this work. Due to its outstanding radiation capabilities, MPA are widely used in wireless communication. Lighter weight lower cost, low profile, compact size, and ease of fabrication are a few benefits. It may be quickly and easily printed directly on the circuit boards. Low gain and limited bandwidth are the main drawbacks of conventional MPA. Numerous methods have been employed to overcome these drawbacks. Feeding type, slots, defective ground structures, frequency selective surfaces, dielectric substrate, shorting pins, metamaterials are a few of the approaches employed. In this study, multiple patch antennas with varying slots for analyzing gain and directivity. These slot antennas are triangular slot (LPSP), multiple slots (NMSPA), rectangular slot (NLMP) and K shaped slot (NLKPA) with different construction materials are designed and compared with conventional microstrip antenna at a 2.4 GHz frequency. These slotted antennas are designed using the Altair Feko simulator. Then, it can be examined using a one-way anova test with an alpha value of 5% and a pretest power of 80%. From this investigation, the low profile with triangular slot patch (LPSP) antenna achieved high directivity (8.65dB) and peak gain (8.58dB) when compared with other antennas.

articleTitle: Smart System for Accident Prevention Using Drunk and Drive Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: People are currently involved in numerous accidents while travelling by car. Drunk driving and reckless driving during peak hours are the leading causes of accidents. This project contributes to the prevention of such accidents by developing a system that, using a sensor, prevents an intoxicated driver from driving the vehicle and, as a result, controls the ignition of the vehicle’s engine. Accidents occur frequently near school zones. As a result, controlling the vehicle speed is the most important aspect to deal with. This mechanism regulates the vehicle’s speed in school, college, and hospital zones when the camera detects school and hospital zone signs. The method for gathering and detecting signs is mainly reliant on digital image processing. The image processing algorithm takes the necessary action for the acquired indicators. The traffic signs were captured using image enhancement techniques through the Raspberry Pi camera port. The features of speed signs are investigated using the embedded system small computing platform. At that period of daytime vision, the Haar Cascade approach had been used for form analysis to distinguish traffic symbols. The proposed work uses Raspberry Pi 3 board to implement the existing traffic signaling technique.

articleTitle: Addendum Parity Check Codes for Futuristic Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: In recent days, wireless communication has become an integral part of human lives. Hence, data transmitted through wireless must be highly reliable. The reliability of the wireless data will be enhanced by incorporating errorcorrecting codes. There are numerous error correction codes available in a wireless communication system. To enhance the error correction capability, in this paper, Addendum Parity Check–Error Detection and Correction (ADDPC–EDAC) code has been developed that corrects all the errors in the message bits. The proposed ADDPC-EDAC code has been designed using cadence 90 nm technology. To evaluate the errorcorrecting capability of the proposed code, BER vs. SNR analysis was carried out for modulation by BPSK over the AWGN channel. The BER vs. SNR analysis is also compared with the existing error correction codes. Compared with the existing error correction codes, the proposed ADDPC-EDAC results outperform by showing a lesser BER. The proposed code consumes less power, occupies a smaller area, and has a lesser delay compared to the existing codes. The proposed error correction scheme can be used for wireless communication.

articleTitle: Web-based Financial Management System Applied to Educational Institutions
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: There is no doubt that in recent years, both web systems and mobile applications, have certainly changed the ways of managing companies, and the education sector has not been oblivious to this change, even during and post pandemic, has been forced to implement solutions both academic and financial administrative management in order to keep running their academic institutions, In this context, I have found it convenient to elaborate the present study in order to determine the influence of web systems in the financial administration of treasury in an educational institution. The method of study is hypothetical deductive, the type of research is applied, its design is pre-experimental. Considering a population comprising two fiscal years 2021 and 2022, of which six months from March-August 2022 have been taken as a sample.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Crop Suitability Prediction and Fertiliser Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 4th International Conference on Electronics and Sustainable Communication Systems (ICESC)
abstract: As the world population grows demand for sustainable agriculture increases. It causes major impacts like rising supply chain costs, not being able to maintain the safety and quality of your products, insufficient communication between parties failure to track and control inventory in warehouses and stores on the food supply chain. Yield forecast which is important for agriculture stakeholders can be obtained by using machine learning models and data from multiple sources. In the previous years, prediction of yield was done manually with the experience of farmers and it was not so accurate. The yield prediction being a major can be solved by the advanced technologies and with the available data. This study offers a system that advises crops appropriate for the region and fertilizers that are suited for crops based on soil measurements to farmers, all based on the yield history of previous years. This agricultural yield forecast and fertilizer recommendation uses machine learning methods. The Random Forest method is used to propose crops since it produces better results than other algorithms, while the K-means clustering technique is used to suggest fertilizers depending on the NPK level of the soil.
